name: a love colored blackbird
source:
A short kinetic novel about a boy who can't stop dreaming and the blackbird that inhabits said dreams.

[From [url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/a-love-colored-blackbird]Itch.io[/url]]

一部短篇無選項視覺小說，講述一個無法停止做夢的男孩，以及棲居於他夢中的烏鶇。

[譯自[url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/a-love-colored-blackbird]Itch.io[/url]]
